findings.title: Required normal evidence-storage gate fails at the reviewed revision
findings.detail: Independent revision-bound compact_evidence audit of protected base 034d6301316d0dade784a61b159c027b83fbce3a to reviewed SHA 275d7f849b31c9fe123c8d8594b88a85d1c25355 exits 1: changed task evidence/review blobs total 38,263,916 bytes against 16,777,216, and four preserved older plain blobs exceed 262,144 bytes. All seventeen revised command captures, own 106-case PostgreSQL suite and hosted 780-case regression pass independently; they do not satisfy this selected-task normal gate or the packet all-normal-gates DoD. The result truthfully remains BLOCKED. No new runtime data-authority bypass was found; approval remains unavailable.
findings.remediation: Keep all historical bytes and frozen/runtime boundaries intact. Resolve storage preservation through a separately authorized, reviewed governance decision or other explicitly compliant mechanism, obtain actual selected-task and installed App-bound normal gate PASS, and commit any resulting task result/evidence change before fresh SHA-bound review. Do not waive budgets, rewrite/delete prior evidence, promote task PASS, or substitute hosted/custom local proofs for the required installed gate.
